hero.title: I'm Leonardo Santos
hero.description: Full Stack Developer focused on building scalable applications and robust RESTful APIs with the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem (Node.js, NestJS, React, and React Native). I combine Clean Code, clean architecture, and relational databases to solve real problems end to end with high performance.

about.label: About
about.title: Who is Leonardo Santos?
about.paragraph1: Full Stack Software Developer with a strong focus on clean architecture, Clean Code, and delivering efficient end-to-end solutions. I have solid experience in the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem, building robust RESTful APIs with Node.js and NestJS as well as modern, fluid interfaces with React and React Native (Expo).
about.paragraph2: I have solid experience with relational databases — PostgreSQL and MySQL — Prisma ORM, and Docker containerization. I hold a degree in Computer Science from Estácio de Sá and combine this technical foundation with a focus on Clean Code, clean architecture, and best practices.

about.label: About
about.title: Who is Leonardo Santos?
about.paragraph1: Full Stack Developer | From Rio de Janeiro | 24 years old. My journey in technology began at the start of 2022, when I discovered that creating software was exactly what I wanted to do with my life. Since then, I graduated in Computer Science from Estácio and have been dedicated to delivering efficient solutions from the database to the user interface.
about.paragraph2: I believe good code is clean code. That is why I apply Clean Code and Clean Architecture principles in my daily work, along with experience in PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM, and Docker. More than writing lines of code, driven by daily curiosity, my goal is to transform complex ideas into efficient, elegant solutions that truly make a difference.
